ideas.name: S&P 500 Put Expiration Timing
ideas.claim: Returns from shorting out-of-the-money S&P 500 put options are concentrated in the few days before expiration.
ideas.quote: We document empirically that the returns from shorting out-of-the-money S&P 500 put options are concentrated in the few days preceding their expiration.

rules.timeframe: last days of the front-month option cycle
rules.entry: Short out-of-the-money front-month put options during the last days of the cycle; exact entry not stated

ideas.claimed_result: Returns are concentrated in the few days preceding expiration; a numerical value is not stated.
